historical_base.period_consistency: Revenue and FCFF both use Latest fiscal year.

historical_base.capex_treatment: Latest reported capex is included in the historical FCFF base; future capital intensity is embedded in forecast FCFF margins.
historical_base.stock_based_compensation_treatment: Added back to accounting FCFF; economic cost reflected through dilution

historical_fcff_reconciliation.sbc_treatment: Added back to accounting FCFF; economic cost reflected through dilution
historical_fcff_reconciliation.reason: NOPAT-based and CFO-based FCFF reconcile within tolerance.
historical_fcff_reconciliation.other_adjustments_basis: Explicit deferred-tax and other non-cash statement rows; SBC is separate and non-operating gain/loss reversals are excluded because NOPAT already excludes them.
